skill.name: market-research-reports
skill.description: Create comprehensive market research reports with LaTeX templates, structured research workflows, market sizing frameworks, competitive analysis, and visual generation guidance.
skill.summary: Build consulting-style market research reports with structured analysis, visuals, and LaTeX output.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Static findings are false positives caused by LaTeX figure paths, Markdown code fences, and business analysis terms. The one subprocess call uses fixed local companion scripts with argument-list execution and no shell interpolation. No evidence found for prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: LaTeX examples use ../figures paths that trigger path traversal scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer project-local paths such as figures/ where possible, or document that generated reports must stay inside the report workspace.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples trigger external command false positives.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command examples explicit, fixed, and user-initiated. Avoid wording that implies automatic execution without user confirmation.

remediation.issue: The visual helper script invokes companion tools through subprocess.
remediation.suggestion: Continue using shell=False with argument lists, and validate output directories before writing files in stricter publishing environments.

content.value_statement: Market research reports take time to structure, source, visualize, and format. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a repeatable workflow for professional market analysis reports.
actual_capabilities: Provides a 50-page market research report structure with front matter, core chapters, appendices, and references.
Includes a LaTeX report template and style package for consulting-style PDF output.
Guides market sizing, Porters Five Forces, PESTLE, SWOT, BCG Matrix, and customer segmentation analysis.
Supplies prompts and examples for charts, matrices, infographics, timelines, and risk visuals.
Includes a Python script for generating core market report visuals through companion visual tools.
Defines review checklists for page count, visual completeness, source coverage, bibliography, and PDF rendering.
limitations: It depends on external research sources and companion skills for data gathering and image generation.
It does not verify market data accuracy without user-provided sources or current research.
PDF compilation requires a working LaTeX environment and required packages.
The generated report still needs expert review for assumptions, citations, and strategic conclusions.

use_cases.title: Investment Market Scan
use_cases.description: Build a structured report on market size, growth, competitors, risks, and investment thesis.

use_cases.title: Market Entry Strategy
use_cases.description: Assess regional demand, barriers to entry, customer segments, and go-to-market recommendations.

use_cases.title: Industry Thought Leadership
use_cases.description: Create a polished industry report with frameworks, visuals, citations, and executive-ready formatting.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Market Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a market research report outline for [market]. Include scope, target geography, key questions, required data, and recommended visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Market Size and Growth
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop the market size and growth chapter for [market]. Include TAM, SAM, SOM, CAGR, assumptions, source needs, and visual recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Competitive Landscape
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the competitive landscape for [market]. Include Porters Five Forces, top competitors, positioning matrix, barriers to entry, and strategic implications.

prompt_templates.title: Produce an Executive Report Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full consulting-style market research report for [market]. Include research plan, analysis frameworks, visuals, LaTeX structure, executive summary, recommendations, and review checklist.

output_examples.input: Market entry report for renewable energy storage in North America
output_examples.output: A structured report plan with market definition, growth outlook, regional segmentation, competitive forces, risk analysis, and priority visuals.

output_examples.input: Competitive analysis for cloud computing platforms
output_examples.output: A competitive landscape chapter with five forces ratings, competitor positioning, market share discussion, and strategic group analysis.

output_examples.input: Board-ready market research PDF for AI in healthcare
output_examples.output: A LaTeX-based report package with executive summary, market sizing, regulatory context, customer segmentation, recommendations, and bibliography guidance.

best_practices: Define market scope, geography, time horizon, and audience before generating sections.
Use current sources and document assumptions for every forecast, market size, and competitor claim.
Generate visuals early, then revise captions and analysis after the narrative is complete.
anti_patterns: Do not present market estimates without source attribution or clear assumptions.
Do not generate a long report before agreeing on scope, audience, and decision context.
Do not rely on visuals that cannot be traced to report data or analytical claims.

faq.question: Does this skill collect market data by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides a research workflow and prompts, but current data must come from external sources or companion research tools.

faq.question: Can it create a PDF report?
faq.answer: Yes, it provides LaTeX templates and compile steps. A local LaTeX installation is required.

faq.question: Which strategy frameworks are included?
faq.answer: It covers TAM, SAM, SOM, Porters Five Forces, PESTLE, SWOT, BCG Matrix, customer segmentation, and risk analysis.

faq.question: Can I use it for investor diligence?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure diligence reports, but financial assumptions and source quality require expert review.

faq.question: Does it generate charts and images?
faq.answer: It includes visual prompts and a helper script that rely on companion visual generation skills.

faq.question: Is the output ready without review?
faq.answer: No. Review all citations, calculations, recommendations, and LaTeX output before sharing with stakeholders.
